---
title: "O3 Summarize the results of methods research"
link-citations: true
---

## Definition
These studies aim to synthesize the results of methods research addressing a specific methodological question, including quantitative or qualitative questions.

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples
[Qualitative syntheses of methods research](../approaches/12qualitative-synthesis.qmd): meta-ethnographic synthesis of qualitative studies assessing the reasons for non-retention in clinical trials;[@Skea2019exploring] synthesis of studies assessing factors that impact on trial recruitment.[@Houghton2020factors]

[Quantitative syntheses of methods research](../approaches/13quantitative-synthesis.qmd): meta-analysis of comparisons between machine learning and logistic regression for clinical prediction models;[@Christodoulou2019-ot] meta-analysis of meta-epidemiological studies assessing the impact of blinding in trials;[@Wang2024compelling] meta-analysis of randomized studies comparing blinded versus unblinded risk of bias assessment.[@Morissette2011blinded]

[Informal approaches](../approaches/15informal.qmd): overview of approaches for evaluating heterogeneous treatment effects.[@Lipkovich2023overview]
